verdict.rationale: A password manager could plausibly ship a natural-language assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no way to operate Proton Pass with natural-language commands. The CLI takes structured commands for scripts and CI/CD, and Proton Sentinel uses AI for account-takeover protection; neither is a natural-language interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
